description: This file declares functions related to socket operations, such as obtaining local endpoints, converting socket address structures to/from strings, and getting length of socket address structures. It serves as a stub interface for socket handling in the rtSocket module.
external_methods: rtError rtSocket_GetLocalEndpoint(int fd, struct sockaddr_storage* endpoint)
rtError rtSocketStorage_GetLength(struct sockaddr_storage* endpoint, socklen_t* len)
rtError rtSocketStorage_ToString(struct sockaddr_storage* endpoint, char* buff, int n, uint16_t* port)
rtError rtSocketStorage_FromString(struct sockaddr_storage* soc, char const* path)
